objective: Identify RNA sequences that fold into a specified hairpin secondary structure, so that the platform's ranking can be compared against solutions already known to the challenge author.

known_data.target_shape_description: A four-base-pair stem closing a four-base loop.
known_data.notes: This is a retrospective challenge. The author already holds a set of sequences that reach the target shape; those are withheld from participants and used only to score the platform itself.

governance.attribution: Contributors are named on any publication describing results from this challenge.
governance.publication_policy: Results, including negative results, are published openly. No contribution is assigned to the platform.

validation.provenance: Constructed for this demonstration rather than drawn from a published dataset; a production retrospective challenge would cite the source study and its accession identifiers here.
